🚀 Exciting news!

I'm thrilled to announce that after an incredible two-year journey, our team has reached a pivotal milestone — 10,000 users! 🎉

This isn't just a number. It's a testament to what happens when passion meets purpose.

When we embarked on this journey two years ago as three people in a Leeds co-working space, we had a simple yet groundbreaking vision: to revolutionize how small shops manage inventory. Today, that vision is a reality — empowering entrepreneurs everywhere, underscoring the transformative power of listening to your customers.

Key takeaways from our journey:
- **Community:** 4,000 of those users came from referrals — with zero ad spend
- **Resilience:** We nearly ran out of money in month eight, but every setback is a setup for a comeback
- **Innovation:** We rebuilt our barcode scanner three times to stay cutting-edge

None of this would be possible without our amazing, dedicated, and visionary team. Here's to the next chapter! 💪
